body: When most people think of massage therapy, they picture cozy winter days or stress relief during the busy holiday season — but did you know summer might actually be one of the best times to book your next massage?
Whether you’re feeling sun-soaked, overheated, or just trying to keep up with all the summer fun, here are 10 research-backed reasons why a summer massage should be on your self-care checklist.
High temps drain your energy. Massage helps regulate circulation and supports your body’s natural cooling process — leaving you feeling refreshed, not drained.
2️⃣ Relieve Muscle Tension from Summer Activities
Gardening, boating, hiking, biking — summer fun often means sore muscles. Massage therapy reduces inflammation and helps muscles recover faster so you can keep doing what you love.
